```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

Make functions that calculate summary statistics and apply them to a variable to show that they work.

## Functions

```{r functions}
my_mean <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  sum(x) / length(x)
}

my_var <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  sum((x - my_mean(x))^2) / (length(x) - 1)
}

my_sd <- function(x) sqrt(my_var(x))

my_median <- function(x) {
  x <- sort(x[!is.na(x)])
  n <- length(x)
  if (n %% 2 == 1) x[(n + 1) / 2] else mean(x[n / 2 + 0:1])
}

my_summary <- function(x) {
  c(n = sum(!is.na(x)),
    mean = my_mean(x),
    median = my_median(x),
    sd = my_sd(x),
    min = min(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    max = max(x, na.rm = TRUE))
}
```

## Apply to a variable and check against built-in functions

```{r apply}
x <- mtcars$mpg

my_summary(x)

# Built-in results: these should match the values above
c(mean = mean(x), median = median(x), sd = sd(x))
```
